# Kyoto Family Trip Plan: 4 Relaxed Days for 2 Adults + 2 Kids

A low-walk, kid-friendly itinerary for **2026-03-18 to 2026-03-21** with **one major activity per day** and a total target of **¥180,000 excluding flights**. I’m assuming you’ll stay in central Kyoto or near Kyoto Station to keep transfers simple.

## Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary

### Day 1 — 2026-03-18: Higashiyama Highlights at an Easy Pace
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **Morning:** Arrive, check in, and have a slow start with breakfast near your hotel.
- **Afternoon:** Visit **Kiyomizu-dera** by taxi or bus, then keep it light with a short stroll to a nearby tea shop or souvenir street.
- **Evening:** Early dinner in Gion or Kyoto Station area; return to hotel before the kids get tired.

**Estimated cost:** **¥34,000**
- Local transit/taxi: ¥4,000
- Temple entry/snacks: ¥2,000
- Lunch/dinner: ¥18,000
- Coffee/ice cream/souvenirs: ¥10,000

**Transit tips**
- Use a **taxi for the uphill/steep parts** around Kiyomizu-dera to reduce walking.
- If using buses, avoid peak commuter times; they can be crowded with kids.

---

### Day 2 — 2026-03-19: Arashiyama Nature + Easy River Views
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- **Morning:** Head to **Arashiyama** early and do the **Bamboo Grove** only as a short pass-through.
- **Afternoon:** Choose one main stop: **Tenryu-ji** gardens or a **riverboat / scenic river area** if weather is good.
- **Evening:** Dinner back near Kyoto Station or in Arashiyama if everyone still has energy.

**Estimated cost:** **¥42,000**
- Train/taxi mix: ¥5,000
- Entry fees: ¥3,000
- Lunch: ¥12,000
- Dinner: ¥18,000
- Snacks/ice cream: ¥4,000

**Transit tips**
- Take the **JR Sagano Line** or a taxi depending on your hotel location.
- For a smoother day, **skip the monkey park** unless your kids enjoy hills and extra walking.

---

### Day 3 — 2026-03-20: Kyoto Aquarium + Station Area Comfort Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- **Morning:** Visit **Kyoto Aquarium** for a weather-friendly, kid-friendly main activity.
- **Afternoon:** Rest at **Umekoji Park** or a nearby café, then browse Kyoto Station’s shops.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/c/cf/Kyoto_City_Tram_2000_2001_in_Umekoji_Park.jpg Alt=Afternoon:** Rest at **Umekoji Park** or a nearby café, then browse Kyoto Station’s shops, Kyoto, Japan
- **Evening:** Casual family dinner with easy options like noodles, curry, or set meals.

**Estimated cost:** **¥38,000**
- Transit: ¥2,000
- Aquarium tickets: ¥8,000
- Lunch: ¥12,000
- Dinner: ¥14,000
- Snacks: ¥2,000

**Transit tips**
- This is the easiest low-walk day: use **Kyoto Station area** as your base.
- The aquarium is convenient by **JR or taxi** and works well if anyone needs a break.

---

### Day 4 — 2026-03-21: Fushimi Inari Short Visit + Departure Buffer
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/signpost-split.svg
- **Morning:** Do a **short, family-friendly visit to Fushimi Inari Taisha** and stop after the first scenic section.
- **Afternoon:** Return to hotel, pack, and keep the rest of the day open for shopping or rest.
- **Evening:** Early final meal near your hotel or station before departure.

**Estimated cost:** **¥26,000**
- Transit: ¥2,000
- Food: ¥16,000
- Snacks/shopping: ¥8,000

**Transit tips**
- Go **early** to avoid crowds and heat of the day.
- Keep this as a **short out-and-back** rather than a full mountain walk.

## Family Budget Plan

| Day | Main Focus | Estimated Cost | Pace |
|---|---|---:|---|
| 2026-03-18 | Higashiyama / Kiyomizu-dera | ¥34,000 | Easy |
| 2026-03-19 | Arashiyama | ¥42,000 | Easy |
| 2026-03-20 | Kyoto Aquarium | ¥38,000 | Very easy |
| 2026-03-21 | Fushimi Inari short visit | ¥26,000 | Easy |
| Buffer for extras | Snacks, taxis, souvenirs | ¥40,000 | Flexible |

**Trip total:** **¥140,000–¥160,000** typical
That leaves a comfortable cushion under your **¥180,000** cap for extra taxis, better meals, or shopping.

## Rainy-Day Backup Activities

### 1) Kyoto Railway Museum
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/train-front.svg
- Great for kids, interactive, and mostly indoors.
- Works well as a half-day replacement for Arashiyama or Fushimi Inari.

### 2) Kyoto International Manga Museum
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/book.svg
- Good indoor stop for a relaxed afternoon.
- Best if your kids enjoy reading, drawing, or comics.

### 3) Nishiki Market + Department Store Food Floors
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- Easy to combine with light shopping and snack tasting.
- Minimal walking if you keep it to a short market visit and a nearby department store.
